items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; Schefter notes expected to play.
items.implication: WR1/2 upside returns; possible snap limits per Levitan.
items.opportunity: routes/targets in Rams offense vs depleted Eagles secondary

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; good to go vs Cowboys after hamstring.
items.why: ETR IN list; Rapoport/Texans PR confirm good to go; full practice Friday.
items.implication: Elite WR restart in favorable DvP.
items.opportunity: high target share, red-zone vs DAL secondary inflating WR scores 7.3%

items.why: ETR OUT; Schefter/Rapoport/Vikings official confirm sprained ankle.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Goedert also OUT.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter rules out Smith; Eagles missing key pieces including Baun.
items.implication: Eagles pass game significantly worse; Hurts/others impacted.

items.text: Nacua back great but possible snap limits; Collins excellent DvP spot (DAL inflates WR 7.3%), Texans high implied points.
items.why: Hip return speculation on limits; Cowboys worst vs WR scoring.
items.implication: Start both confidently; Collins elite this week.
items.opportunity: Nacua routes if unlimited; Collins targets/redzone

items.text: Addison truthers moment: home vs weak secondary with Jefferson out. Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun. Price tough start: lost GL/pass work, fumbles, chest, Charbonnet practicing but still long-term positive eye test. McConkey LP-DNP-LP (foot/rib).
items.why: Jefferson absence opens targets; Eagles missing three key; Price role erosion data + injury.
items.implication: Addison start/upgrade; fade Eagles skill if limited; Price sit short-term.
items.opportunity: Addison target share spike; Price handcuffs if any
items.conflict: Price long-term eye test vs current usage loss

items.text: Breece Hall OUT; also AD Mitchell OUT.
items.why: ETR OUT; Schefter lists among players out.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts to backups.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet also OUT.
items.why: ETR OUT; Schefter confirms; DNP Friday after limited.
items.implication: SEA RB thin; role erosion already noted.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Caleb Williams OUT.
items.implication: Backup QBs start; WAS/CHI offenses limited.

items.text: Mike Evans QUESTIONABLE (ribs); GTD, intends to play.
items.why: ETR Q; Schefter GTD; Rapoport notes intends to play through with padding.
items.implication: If out, Kittle/others rise; if in, limited?

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out, CLE allows 88+ yds to RBs); LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, RB5 util, NYG allows 5.1 YPC, double-digit targets).
items.why: Full workhorse role; high utilization + matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS with Penix, 9-194 last, NO allows WR TDs); Garrett Wilson (36% TS w/o Mitchell, CHI soft); Josh Downs (31% TS, 43% RZ, WAS worst vs WR/slot); George Kittle (rising TS, Evans Q, DEN soft vs TE).
items.why: High share + matchup data; teammate absences.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low util 3.5% TS/25% routes, 42% snaps, SEA 2.9 YPC); Justin Herbert (44% pressure, SEA elite pass D, low total); Emeka Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total); Xavier Worthy (shrinking TS vs Rice, LV tough); Kyle Pitts (low TS/yards w/ Penix).
